A top-notch veterinary clinic!

A warm welcome, a friendly and caring team. My dog ​​was operated on by Dr. Marine Renoux, who was wonderful. You can tell she loves her job, is highly competent, and truly cares for our animals. Excellent care; I highly recommend them!

Hello,
We are pleased to have been able to contribute positively to your pet's health. Your feedback encourages us to maintain this level of excellence.
We remain at your disposal should you have any questions or future veterinary needs.

Your Veterinary Team
Always attentive
Very professional and friendly people, I highly recommend them
Excellent welcome and the vet was fantastic, thank you for Aslan

A huge thank you to Dr. Razaire and the entire team for their professionalism and expertise. I've known this doctor for almost 20 years, and he's a rare gem, the kind you just don't see anymore. He's so kind and reassuring, and very honest too, which is what I appreciate most about this veterinarian. You can go to him with complete confidence; I have total trust in him! Thank you again for Lili; she's doing so much better since her last visit. See you soon for her annual vaccination! 😃
I recommend Dr. Martel. He is a very conscientious and efficient person.

Hello,
Your trust and positive feedback towards our team mean a great deal to us.

We are delighted that our care was beneficial for your pet.

We remain available to provide you with convenient service and answer any questions you may have.

Your veterinary team

We would like to warmly thank Dr. Olivier Razaire and the entire team at the Argos Clinic for their excellent care of our little furry friend, Bubbles, following his fracture. The operation went perfectly, and the doctor's invaluable advice and the team's impeccable follow-up were incredibly reassuring. A huge thank you for their kindness, attentiveness, and outstanding professionalism from beginning to end. We wholeheartedly recommend the clinic!
The vet is competent and attentive; all the staff are caring and, above all, they love animals much more than money.
Top team
Competent and attentive, I highly recommend this clinic!
Vaccinations for both dogs. Excellent reception and thorough care provided by competent veterinarians. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic to everyone.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I would like to thank the entire team at this veterinary clinic for their professionalism and kindness. The two young women at reception were very kind, smiling, and gave me a warm welcome, which is very reassuring when you're worried about your pet.

A big thank you also to Dr. Martel, who was attentive, reassuring, and very professional. I particularly appreciated her honesty: she didn't try to add unnecessary tests or treatments simply to charge more, which is unfortunately sometimes the case in some clinics. She took the time to explain things thoroughly and kindly, prioritizing my cat's well-being above all else and answering all my questions.

I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. Thank you again for your kindness and compassion. 🐾🫶🏼

Hello, I wanted to thank Dr. Razaire Olivier for saving my cat from his itching. You are a miracle worker! My cat Simba no longer scratches, and his fur has grown back beautifully. Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart, especially since I was so stressed. You are his angel! Thank you!

Hello,

We are delighted that our care was beneficial for your pet.

We remain available to provide you with convenient service and answer any questions you may have.

Your veterinary team

Attentive and full of good advice, I've found my vet to support me throughout my pet's life 🥰.

Thank you so much
A pleasant and professional team, who truly love animals. They take their time with both the animal and us owners, they answer our questions and nothing is rushed.

When I see my cat suffering every day, I think back to that vet and everything that happened. I'm so disgusted and sickened by the whole experience. From the very beginning, they should have just told me, "Madam, we're not qualified to perform this type of procedure." I would never have risked entrusting my cat to someone who had never performed this kind of surgery before.

And when I called the receptionist for answers, she told me, "Madam, stop calling us; your cat's intestines aren't going to grow back." Then they explained that it was normal because it was the first time they had performed this type of surgery.

Even now, when I see my cat suffering, those words haunt me. It's a situation I can't forget.
All the team members are truly very competent and kind. Highly recommended.
Prompt service, attentive doctor, and pleasant staff

I would like to thank the entire team at the clinic.

The receptionists were very pleasant and welcoming.
I was seen by Dr. Hamel, who was very patient with my kitten, who was suffering from unexplained vomiting.
The treatment was effective the very next day.
It was a wonderful experience.

I had to go to the emergency vet today for my kitten KiKi after an accident with the small TV screen that fell on him… Thank goodness, nothing serious… A huge thank you to Dr. Hamel, an exceptional vet with a big heart 🤍 Thank you for your warm welcome and professionalism. Thank you so much 🥹🤲🏻
Yasmine, Biscuit & KiKi's mom

A top-notch clinic, an exceptional team. They've been caring for my dogs for over 10 years now. Dr. Razaire, Dr. Hammel, and especially Caro, who is outstanding, along with the secretaries and the entire clinic team, are incredibly kind, compassionate, and humane. They've been with me every step of the way for my two big dogs. I am so grateful and thank you so much for your kindness. Thank you to the whole team for your humanity and kindness; a truly exceptional team, the kind you don't find everywhere.
Great clinic!

Thank you!
A warm welcome, and good vets who know their job very well – highly recommended, serious people and reasonable prices

The receptionists and assistants are exceptional: very kind, very professional, dedicated to their work, and above all, they love animals. The veterinarians are very professional. I'm very happy with this clinic. I give it 20/20.

Good evening, they saved my cat Simba 🐱 I thank them from the bottom of my heart. They are the only human vets who love animals; their job is to save animals, not their bank account. Thank you a million times! …
The staff are fantastic; they listen to us and are very kind to our four-legged friends, and their diagnosis was excellent.

Thank you to the entire team of assistants and a special thank you to Dr. Hamel for his exceptional professionalism.

My cat received prompt and excellent care. The team was very attentive and responsive. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. Thank you to the team! :)

Great staff

Highly recommended

I've always known this address, since 1970, with the veterinarian Dr. Martinez. Then, of course, the clinic opened, and it's very useful; I've taken all the cats I've ever had here. Despite the changes, it's still good veterinarians who care for our little friends, cats, dogs, and other animals... Mrs. Anne-Marie Baille (no photo, no smartphone).
Excellent vet, it's a shame I didn't know him sooner, I highly recommend him

This clinic has treated all my dogs and my cat. I've been a loyal customer for over 15 years and I highly recommend it. Always attentive, available, and very compassionate. My father-in-law has been bringing his dogs here for over 40 years, and for my sister-in-law and us, it's a family-run clinic for our furry friends.

Too bad, I can't give more stars... We arrived at the Argos clinic in an emergency from Grenoble.
There was less than a 10-minute wait for my Okki's consultation with Dr. Razaine, who was very professional. He explained everything and reassured me about my little dog Okki's health.
Marion, Caroline, and Alexandra, the assistants, were very kind, smiling, and also incredibly professional.
A thousand thanks for your welcome, the speed of service, and the truly reasonable price.
Truly excellent.
Donatella and Okki from Grenoble.

Excellent veterinary clinic. Booking an appointment on their website is quick and easy, the receptionists are very friendly and accommodating, and the veterinarian who treated our cat was attentive and highly competent. He was the only vet, after two other consultations elsewhere, who immediately diagnosed our cat's problem and was able to examine her without any issues because he knows how to handle cats. He was very available to answer all our questions. I highly recommend this clinic, especially since the prices are very reasonable. Thank you again.
Quick appointment booking, friendly welcome, and a punctual, professional, and attentive veterinarian.

An exceptional clinic!! The best in Marseille, and I mean it!!! I brought my cat in when she was critically ill. The vet is incredibly kind! He treats animals out of passion, not for money. A thousand thanks to you, Doctor, for treating my cat; you are a wonderful person.
Thanks also to the entire team, who are all fantastic!

I highly recommend this clinic for the quality of care, follow-up, and advice!
Dr. Razaire loves his work, and it shows!

A warm welcome and attentive staff!

A unique touch: they call the animal, not the owner – a real sign of empathy for animals!

I've been going to this veterinary clinic for 10 years, and I highly recommend it.
Everyone is welcoming, professional, and takes excellent care of our animals. They have a very human touch; they are truly passionate about what they do.
Well done and thank you to the whole team!

Excellent clinic.
The veterinarians and staff are extremely competent, caring, and available.

I highly recommend this clinic. The veterinarians are passionate and treat animals like humans, and the receptionists are fantastic. The whole team is exceptionally kind these days. Romy also thanks you, Ms. Perrin.
I recommend this veterinary clinic with a very friendly and attentive care team and highly competent veterinarians at a really reasonable price.
Good veterinarian
I highly recommend these top-notch vets – very professional and, above all, humane!

A top-quality clinic; I've been a client for over twenty years. The staff treats animals as living beings, not just as wallets.

The caregivers are wonderful and lovely.
The doctors are compassionate and empathetic.
I wouldn't change clinics for anything.

I've been to this veterinary clinic twice and I haven't been disappointed at all. In April, I had to have my two female cats spayed, and the whole team was wonderful. Then, two days ago, I said goodbye to my 15-year-old baby... and the team was wonderful and understanding. Despite the difficult experience, the veterinary team was amazing with my little baby and allowed him to pass away peacefully in my arms. I thank Dr. Kohl, who made this difficult moment so beautiful... I couldn't have dreamed of a better goodbye. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic for its professionalism, passion, and also its very humane approach. Thank you again for everything you did for my little angel.

I highly recommend this clinic. The veterinarians are truly passionate, very kind and attentive, and they really take care of our animals. The receptionists are also great. I am delighted and thank them again for everything they did for my animals and the support I received during difficult times. Perfect for me!

I've been taking my pets to this veterinary clinic for a very long time.

I'm incredibly grateful to the team for their kindness and the excellent care they give our furry friends.

I especially want to thank Dr. Valadier, who took care of my little Nouchka and my little Simba back then.

He's now retired.

A special shout-out to Dr. Hamel, who looks after my cats. He's wonderful with them, very kind and gentle when he examines them. The team is fantastic—helpful and respectful. They have such affection and love for animals. I love it! 💓 Thank you to the whole team for being there. …
I thank the whole team for their great work, we really feel supported.

Dr. Hamel literally saved our dog. I can't thank him enough, nor all the staff at the clinic. They are all dedicated and genuinely love animals. Thank you for everything: your kindness, your expertise, and your very reasonable fees.

The reception staff and veterinarians were very competent and compassionate. I had my cat euthanized today because she was very old, and they gave me time to say goodbye.
I have complete confidence in them.
My dog ​​is seen by Mr. Razaire and I've never been disappointed! He's always attentive and gives great advice!

My two dogs are patients at this clinic! The reception is always perfect, and the receptionists are very pleasant! The veterinarians are gentle and attentive to our requests, and the animals are reassured and pampered! I highly recommend this clinic!!!!

Today I had an appointment with Princess Uka, a cat who was completely voiceless. We received a wonderful welcome; Dr. Hamel took care of my little darling with great gentleness and explanations. I finally know what's wrong with her. In fact, Uka thanks you, Dr. Hamel. I don't know what was in the injection, but as soon as we got home, she went straight to her food bowl and begged for food, which I happily gave her. She hadn't asked for it in several days. A huge thank you!

Emergency Veterinarian Call on Sunday, November 10th: Dr. Hamel took care of my cat, who is not easy to treat. Dr. Hamel was kind, gentle, and patient, explained things well, and took his time. I recommend him for follow-up appointments at the clinic.

I recommend passionate person, very good diagnosis, does not work only for money and in our time there are not many centers like this left, I say thank you to the whole team, I like people who work with passion, you deserve good publicity and good luck, Tigrou is much better, a thousand thanks 🙏 …
The staff are incredibly kind and welcoming; our pets are very well cared for and treated with respect, and the prices aren't exorbitant. I highly recommend this place.
very attentive and competent staff

I loved the services, from the reception staff to the veterinarians, all very polite and receptive, and above all, super professional...
